verdict.rationale: Poly ships an official remote MCP server at mcp.poly.app with OAuth sign-in and safeguards against irreversible actions, so any MCP-compatible assistant can connect. It also provides an official Claude Code plugin that loads Poly memory and connects the MCP server, a poly-cli agent skill, and a stated plugin for Claude, ChatGPT and VS Code. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the connectors working, and specific setup docs for the ChatGPT and VS Code integrations beyond the marketing mention.
